description: Dept. of Elections - Elected Mr. Mudali Maheepala Appuhamillage Waruna Pradeep Maheepala as a member of the Gampaha Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Gampaha Municipal Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the process triggered by a member ceasing to belong to their political party and the subsequent nomination and declaration of a new elected member by the Returning Officer. The core subject matter is an electoral process for a local authority, making it a clear fit for the Elections category.
